mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_image_url AS cardImageUrl, uc.pan_last4 AS panLast4, c.annual_fee AS annualFee, DATE(p.payment_time) AS benefitDate, COALESCE(SUM(p.discount_amount), 0) AS dailyBenefitAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND p.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.payment_time >= #{startPaymentTime} AND p.payment_time < #{endPaymentTime} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.annual_fee > 0 GROUP BY uc.user_card_id, c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_image_url, uc.pan_last4, c.annual_fee, DATE(p.payment_time), uc.is_primary, uc.created_at ORDER BY uc.is_primary DESC, uc.created_at ASC, benefitDate ASC

SELECT mc.category_code AS categoryCode, mc.category_name AS categoryName, SUM(p.discount_amount) AS categoryAmount FROM payments p INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = p.user_card_id INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.category_code = m.category_code WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.payment_time >= #{startPaymentTime} AND p.payment_time < #{endPaymentTime} GROUP BY mc.category_code, mc.category_name ORDER BY categoryAmount DESC

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.user_card_id AS userCardId, mc.category_code AS categoryCode, mc.category_name AS categoryName, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, m.brand_id AS brandId, p.original_amount AS originalAmount, p.payment_time AS paymentTime FROM payments p INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = p.user_card_id INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.category_code = m.category_code WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.payment_time >= #{startPaymentTime} AND p.payment_time < #{endPaymentTime} ORDER BY p.payment_time DESC

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.benefits_info AS benefitsInfo, COALESCE(cms.total_spending_amount, 0) AS previousMonthSpendingAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_monthly_status cms ON cms.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND cms.target_year_month = #{previousYearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.recommendation_enabled = TRUE AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_supported = TRUE ORDER BY uc.is_primary DESC, uc.created_at ASC

SELECT ubms.user_card_id AS userCardId, ubms.category_code AS categoryCode, ubms.used_benefit_amount AS usedBenefitAmount, ubms.usage_count AS usageCount FROM user_card_benefit_monthly_status ubms INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubms.user_card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubms.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.recommendation_enabled = TRUE AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_image_url AS cardImageUrl, c.benefits_info AS benefitsInfo, COALESCE(cms.total_spending_amount, 0) AS previousMonthSpendingAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_monthly_status cms ON cms.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND cms.target_year_month = #{previousYearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY uc.is_primary DESC, uc.created_at DESC

SELECT p.user_card_id AS userCardId, mc.category_code AS categoryCode, COALESCE(SUM(p.discount_amount), 0) AS usedAmount, COUNT(*) AS usedCount FROM payments p INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = p.user_card_id INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.category_code = m.category_code WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.discount_amount > 0 AND p.payment_time >= #{startPaymentTime} AND p.payment_time < #{endPaymentTime} GROUP BY p.user_card_id, mc.category_code

SELECT m.latitude, m.longitude FROM payments p INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = p.user_card_id INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY p.payment_time DESC LIMIT 1
